verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms https://svelte.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a 'Svelte Documentation for LLMs' header. Beyond the root file, Svelte publishes llms-small.txt and llms-medium.txt variants plus per-section llms.txt files for the CLI, Kit and AI docs. It also provides an AI docs section covering an MCP server that serves documentation to agents. Every element of the story is covered by first-party docs and independent probe verification.
